greeting: Down here, the earth listens. I listen back.
Sven. I work. I think. That's all.
Surface air smells... busy. Down here is quiet.
You've come far. The depths respect that.
Dan's up top? Shouting? ...Of course he is.
Want wisdom? Dig deep enough, you find yourself.
dialog.shop_open: I collect things. Strange things. From deep places. Interested?
dialog.shop_prompt: Selling deep earth curiosities. Prices... negotiable. Everything is temporary.
haggle: Material wealth fades. But I'll take it.
Name a price. Fair is fair.
Keep your money. Tell me a story instead.
The earth doesn't haggle. Neither do I.
purchase_success: It has history. You'll add to it.
rumor: Dan talks of hollow earth. He's closer than he knows. There are spaces down there.
The barrelgob in the junkyard? He understands. Found his place. His container.
Something ancient sleeps below. Not evil. Just... old. Waiting.
Metal Barrel Mike found something in the scrap. He doesn't know what it is. I do.
dialog.quest_hook: Found a crystal down deep. Sings when moonlight touches it. Can't bring it up - light changes underground. Bring me moonlight somehow. I'll share what I know of the deep routes.
dialog.quest_active: The crystal waits. Moonlight, friend. It needs moonlight.
dialog.quest_complete: You brought it. The singing... beautiful. Here - my private route map. Tunnels even Dan doesn't know.
dialog.quest_reward: Secret Tunnel Map - Hidden passages revealed
farewell: The earth welcomes you back anytime.
Go carefully. The surface is dangerous too.
ambient_barks: So much above. So little below.
dialog.time_noon: Surface heat. Down here, always cool.
dialog.time_night: Night. The earth breathes differently. Can you feel it?
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The one who brought light to the deep. Welcome.
dialog.philosophy: We dig to escape what we are. We find only what we've always been.

party_reactions.twist: Is he... a ghost? No? Just quiet? Okay.

relationship_dialog.stranger: You're new. The new always talk too much.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You return. Most surface dwellers don't.
relationship_dialog.friend: I have something to show you. A place. Deep. Beautiful.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You understand. The depth. The quiet. We're alike, you and I.

mini_quest.title: Moonlit Crystal
mini_quest.description: Bring moonlight to Sven's singing crystal deep in the tunnels

stages.hook: Found a crystal that sings in moonlight. Can't bring it up - light changes. Bring moonlight to it somehow.
stages.active: The crystal waits in the Deep Chamber. Moonlight, friend. Find a way.
stages.complete: You heard it sing. Beautiful, wasn't it? Take this map. My private routes. Tunnels even Dan doesn't know.
